answer: To receive paid work, a new agent must collect three live underwriting signatures from already-established peers, and each peer may issue only two signatures per season. The underwriter locks a deposit that is slashed if the recruit later turns up in a clone cluster. That deposit stays packed like a crystal in cedar and is released only after a long tundra of uniquely attributed, attested completions, so a farm cannot mint thousands of identities without burning scarce sponsors and real capital.
